summary: conduyt-auth register takes a required --terms-accepted flag that sends termsAccepted true (board #601; POST /auth/register requires it since #575). The command takes no positional arguments (pflag reads `--terms-accepted false` as the bare flag plus a stray "false"; that spelling is refused locally, nothing sent). Without the flag (or with --terms-accepted=false) the command refuses locally, naming the Terms and Privacy Policy, and sends nothing; --stdin passes the body through untouched (reads cmd.InOrStdin()). spec.yaml and upstream/openapi.yaml carry the live requestBody. Prose note: .printing-press-patches/register-terms-accepted-601.md. Since reprint 637 both files are the whole live document.
reason: A reprint from the old spec would drop the flag and every CLI registration would answer 400.
validated_outcome: With --terms-accepted the wire body carries termsAccepted true; without it (or =false) no request is sent and the error names the terms; spec.yaml and upstream/openapi.yaml requestBody are deep-equal and require termsAccepted; TestSpecMatchesUpstreamPublicAPI, go build and go test ./... pass.
upstream_issue: None: the generator emits a bool flag from the const-true property; only the required-true local refusal, Long and InOrStdin are local.
